# proton-mail-bridge-cli

> Unofficial agent-native CLI for the Proton Mail Bridge (local IMAP/SMTP gateway). Search, read,
> send, and organize Proton Mail with JSON output for AI agents. Multi-account fan-out, robust
> WSL→Windows connectivity. Python 3.11+, Apache-2.0. Not affiliated with Proton.

## Install
`uv tool install git+https://github.com/evrenverse/proton-mail-bridge-cli` — command `proton-mail-bridge` / `pmb`.

## Quickstart
`pmb account add` then `pmb --json message search --text "..." --with-body`.

## Rules for agents
- Always `--json`; bulk-first (one task = 1–3 calls).
- No `--account` → fan-out over all accounts for search/list (results tagged with `account`).
- One account can own several sender addresses: `--identity <label|address>` picks the sender
  (and thereby the account); `pmb --json account list` shows them.
- Discovery: `pmb --help`, `pmb describe <path...>` (e.g. `describe account identity add`),
  `pmb fields message`.
- Writes are risk-tiered (🟢/🟡/🔴); every writing command previews with `--dry-run` (changes
  nothing, needs no confirmation); never auto-`--yes`.
